title: Field-aware invert of a prior GroupClips command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip GroupClips or UngroupClips command restores only that command's grouping write set (selectionGroups and selectionGroupId) when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later default MoveClips of the group that only changes geometry does not conflict: invert dissolves the group and keeps the moved remnants and already-followed cues.

A later UngroupClips of the same group, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. Invert of a prior UngroupClips after a later single-member move restores only the group membership and leaves the later geometry and cues. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores.

A real UI path extracts persistent audio, splits, adds left and right cues, groups the remnants, commits a multi-select move, inverts the GroupClips command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip.

Already-delivered caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, insert-move leave-gap, SetTrackState locked, invert of SetCaptions and SetMarkers, overwrite, LiftClips/Cut, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, video/caption mute/solo, syncLock, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND. An uncovering or cropping interval remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.
